The child‑killing US and Zionist demons martyred the young students of the Shajarah Tayyibah [Blessed Tree] School. But the Iranian nation will plant seedlings of hope throughout the land, so that each one, God willing, will bear abundant fruit in the years to come.
One such commendable action is for people in all cities and villages to plant fruit trees starting from Nature Day and continuing until the end of spring.
At a time when the US-Zionist enemy has even attacked the natural environment and ecological spaces of our beloved homeland, any efforts aimed at development are necessary acts.

The heroic nation of Iran has intertwined this Nowruz with an epic spirit and a deep sense of honor. After commemorating the 12th of Farvardin, which is the National Islamic Republic Day, they now prepare to welcome Nature Day.
